response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Paragraph beginning “We are not stoics”","severity":"minor","source_quote":"We are not stoics—we hurt and cry when loved ones leave us.","suggested_fix":"Replace “watu wasiojali” with wording meaning people who suppress or do not show their emotions, such as “stoiki,” so the contrast with hurting and crying is preserved.","translation_quote":"Sisi si watu wasiojali—huumia na kulia wapendwa wanapotutoka."},{"location":"Paragraph beginning “We are not ‘drop-outs’”","severity":"major","source_quote":"We are not “drop-outs” because we don’t hold “respectable, secure” jobs—we’re “sold-outs.”","suggested_fix":"Replace “waliotupa” with a term meaning people who have dropped out or opted out, preserving the contrast with being fully committed to Christ; for example, “Sisi si ‘waliojitoa’ kwa sababu hatuna kazi ‘zenye heshima na usalama’—sisi ‘tumejitoa kikamilifu.’”","translation_quote":"Sisi si “waliotupa” kwa sababu hatuna kazi “zenye heshima na usalama”—sisi “tumejitoa kikamilifu.”"},{"location":"Image alt text","severity":"minor","source_quote":"A black-and-white globe centered on Africa","suggested_fix":"Specify that the image shows a globe, for example: “Tufe la dunia nyeusi na nyeupe, Afrika ikiwa katikati.”","translation_quote":"Dunia yenye rangi nyeusi na nyeupe, Afrika ikiwa katikati"}],"findings_complete":true,"passed":false,"score":93}
